title: Use Features and Publish in Chatflow Studio after a publish toast closes
steps: Open Publish, choose Publish Update, and inspect the validation toast over the Studio header.
Click the toast's X, then immediately click the center of the same toast before its fade-out completes.
After the toast is visually gone, click Features and then Publish.

video_guide.summary: Watch the Features and Publish controls after the publish-error toast disappears. Neither opens its panel during the subsequent click attempts.

chapters.note: A publish attempt displays an error toast above the publishing popup.
The toast and popup are no longer visible.
The editor remains visible without a Features drawer.
The editor remains visible without the publishing popup.
